title: piper calocoma
intro: Piper calocoma, commonly known as the Malabar long pepper, is a species of flowering plant in the family Piperaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Piper calocoma include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of pain, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Piper calocoma include piperine, beta-carboline alkaloids, and terpenes, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
